about: Starter files Settings → Setup offers a repository on the games list (0.89.0, docs/design-record.md, Setup). Each is written only when the person saw it whole and pressed Write, only where its path is free, and never over a file. `present` says how the Companion knows the repository already has one: `changelog` is any CHANGELOG.md up to three folders down (as the tool kit's changes finds them); `file` is the path itself. A starter `forAgents` is offered only while the features for AI agent sessions are shown. A starter with `fields` and a `template` is a form (0.93.0): each field is checked by its kind (src-tauri/core/src/starters.rs) and put where the template says {{id}}; `needs: install-adapter` offers it only for a game the tool kit can install mods for. Its words are English here, as the chat agents' are.

starters.content:
# Changelog

What changed in each version, newest first. Each version is a heading such as `## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-25`, with sections such as `### Added`, `### Changed` and `### Fixed`, and one entry per line starting with `- `. Work not released yet goes under Unreleased. Commit a change with its entry, in one commit.

## [Unreleased]

# Outstanding work

What is still to do. Home lists the rows whose status is open, in progress, waiting or blocked.
